text:
Maya: Quick ops thread — Thursday 10am PT webinar. Need a resilient recording + post-event asset flow: cloud recording, local OBS backup, RTMP fallback to Loom, auto-transcript, S3 upload, and HubSpot lead webhook. Assign owners?

Ravi: I can take Zoom config + uploads. My checklist: cloud recording (speaker+gallery), enable audio transcript (VTT), add co-host Bea, local OBS recording on host laptop (MP4), set alternative RTMP to Loom as a hot spare. Keep 'Only authenticated users' OFF.

Bea: I'll handle registration page and confirmation emails. Required fields: email, company, role. Add a short field: "primary inference constraint" (optional). Need hidden UTMs and form GUID. Tag: webinar_prodserve_0514.

Luis: I'll run edit pipeline + snack clips. Need raw MP4 + VTT + plain transcript. Deliverables: 1x 90s highlight, 2x 30s reels (9:16), one 15s hook (sound-on). Please name raw files: `WPS0514_raw.mp4`, `WPS0514_transcript.txt`. Also want speaker timestamps.txt.

Ravi: Upload plan after end: 1) download cloud MP4 & VTT from Zoom 2) grab local OBS MP4 3) upload both to S3 `s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-05-14-prod-serve/raw/` 4) set ACL marketing-editors 5) copy public-allowed replay to signed URL location. I'll post Drive link for editors.

Ravi: Quick CLI for upload (manual):
```
aws s3 cp "WPS0514_raw_cloud.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-05-14-prod-serve/raw/WPS0514_cloud.mp4" --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 cp "WPS0514_raw_local.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-05-14-prod-serve/raw/WPS0514_local.mp4"
aws s3 cp "transcript.vtt" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-05-14-prod-serve/raw/WPS0514_transcript.vtt"
```

MediaBot: RTMP fallback preconfigured: if Zoom cloud recording fails, stream pushed to Loom at rtmp://rtmp.loom.com/xxxxx.

Bea: Reg page draft: HS GUID = 0a1b2c3d. Fields: [email, firstname, lastname, company, role, primary_inference_constraint, utm_source, utm_campaign]. Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-leads. Lead routing: tag = webinar_prodserve_0514, assign = round_robin(webinar_ops).

Luis: For editing please include speaker camera cut ranges in timestamps.txt. If OBS local recording exists, prefer it for camera shots (higher frame rate). I'll convert VTT -> SRT and export captions burned & separate.

Maya: Post-event cadence (proposal):
- 1h: replay email (private link + 1-line takeaways + demo CTA)
- 12h: highlights email + social reel push (focus stat: "latency down 40% for long-tail requests")
- 48h: full edited recording + blog summary + transcript
- 5 days: nurture + cohorting based on role/company size; handoff to SDRs for MQLs

Ravi: Note: we'll generate a signed S3 URL for 30 days for the replay. I'll include in the 1h email. Also will tag attendees in HubSpot with webinar_prodserve_0514.

Bea: I'll A/B test confirmation email 1: adds calendar invite with direct dial. 2: adds calendar + short prep doc. Will report variant CTR.

Maya: Owners recap: Reg page + tracking = Bea; Zoom host + upload pipeline = Ravi; Editing & clips = Luis; Cadence & replay copy = Maya. Deadline: raw upload + Drive link within 90 minutes of end; clips first pass in 36 hours.

ZoomBot: Recording started by host Ravi at 10:03 AM PT.

Ravi: Quick reminder: if host loses connection, co-host (Bea) can stop/start recording and local OBS will still have backup. Also keep a note to pull transcript.vtt immediately after recording ends.

MediaBot: Loom RTMP streaming active as backup.

Maya: I'll do a final registration smoke test at 2pm PT and post results here. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:

ZoomBot: Recording ended at 11:12 AM PT. Cloud recording available: https://zoom.us/rec/share/EXAMPLE_WPS0514 (restricted).
